text:
Ethan (eng-sre): Postmortem follow-up for the Ember dedicated/on-prem isolation. Goal: lock owners, short milestones, and surface recurring patterns so we can close the loop. I will shepherd until next Tues.

Priya (eng-platform): I can own the VPC peering propagation fix. Initial plan: add ordered route writes + 15s reconcile backoff. Target: next Fri EOD.

Rohan (eng-runtime): I will draft the rollback playbook and a canary harness that primes KV before traffic shift. Need an ephemeral mirrored tenant to run the canary.

Mei (infra): Will implement a peer-health probe (2m cadence) and a route-staleness metric (withdraw/announce churn). Question: do we want automated fallback after 20m of sustained failures or just page?

Ethan (eng-sre): Start with pager + pre-armed failover. If anomalies continue >20m, trigger failover to regional pool. Document the sequence in runbook.

Gwen (prodops): Provisioned mirror tenant ember-mirror-72h and granted Rohan access (72h TTL). I also drafted a customer-facing status template; happy to run it by Ember ops.

incident-bot: Created issue #5899 "ember-onprem-peering-propagation" and linked to postmortem. Assignee: Priya. Due: 2024-07-05.

Priya (eng-platform): PR outline: ordered writes, reconcile-delay param, and unit tests simulating rapid re-advertise. Will drop link when ready.

Rohan (eng-runtime): Canary infra provisioned on mirror tenant. Smoke checks: connectivity OK, KV primed. Starting small load step.

Mei (infra): Probe deployed to staging. Will run a 1-hour spike test tomorrow to validate false-positive rate.

Ethan (eng-sre): Two recurring patterns to add to recurring-incidents board: (1) BGP flaps during peak writes -> transient isolation, (2) route reconciliation races when on-prem controllers re-advertise prefixes. Add suggested mitigations to each card.

Priya (eng-platform): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/900 (WIP). Adding reviewers @Rohan @Ethan.

Rohan (eng-runtime): Canary results: small load step showed stable behavior; will extend to 5m sustained load.

Ethan (eng-sre): Daily close: Priya PR -> WIP; Rohan canary -> running; Mei probe -> staging; Gwen comms -> ready. Next check-in Monday 09:30 PT. Post one-line updates here as progress is made.
